entities.name: UniProt Q04941 PLP2
observations: The 152-aa query sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed human proteolipid protein 2 (PLP2; UniProt Q04941).
Sequence-derived estimates: 16.69 kDa, pI 6.80, GRAVY 0.765; these do not account for processing or modifications.
Pfam detects a MARVEL domain at residues 20–131; reviewed annotation describes PLP2 as a multipass membrane protein and suggests a role in intestinal epithelial cell differentiation.
